provenance.method: Each item is one FoodData Central record exactly as the GoHard rebuild API normalized it in GET /api/v1/foods/search: sourceId is the FDC ID, and the values, basis and portions are the record's own. The record for each everyday name was chosen by review. Name, qualifier, category and aliases are GoHard's labels for finding the food; they are not USDA data. Built by scripts/build-common-foods.mjs from scripts/common-foods.spec.json.
